baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person plural verb at word 2 (root ف ع ل) supplies agency, while the governed plural at word 3 (root ج ر م) names the affected class through offense.
baseline_models.mechanism: The manner-deictic at word 1 presents an already patterned intervention as being deliberately brought into effect upon a guilt-defined class.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being makes the clause an enacted intervention rather than a bare verdict.
Guilt and offense define the recipients juridically and supply the intervention's target class.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that something similar is done to criminals.
changed_reading.after: A prior pattern is deliberately reenacted upon a class constituted by culpable offense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The acting verb at word 2 (root ف ع ل) stands in relation to the prepositionally governed class at word 3 (root ج ر م).
baseline_models.mechanism: The mutual-action branch of ف ع ل and the earning-or-incurrence branch of ج ر م make the clause potentially responsive: the recipients' acquisition of liability occasions a counter-action.

activation_trace.role: Mutual action between two participants opens a responsive relation rather than a wholly unilateral event.
Earning or causing liability supplies the recipients' acquired contribution to the response.

changed_reading.before: The divine action is unilateral treatment of a fixed group.
changed_reading.after: The action can be heard as a response incurred through what the group has acquired or caused.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The target noun at word 3 carries root ج ر م, whose packet inventory includes severing and harvesting, under the enacted verb at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material branch overlays culpability with severance: the action becomes a decisive cutoff or harvest applied to those marked by the root, without replacing the ordinary offense reading.

activation_trace.role: Act-production supplies the operation that realizes the material cutoff.
Cutting off and harvesting gives the target class an exploratory severance profile.

changed_reading.before: The target is only a moral category receiving an unspecified act.
changed_reading.after: The moral category also supports an exploratory image of a population being decisively cut from continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair supplies a repeatable procedure: an earlier cohort is destroyed and a later cohort is made to follow it. The focus manner-deictic then generalizes that sequence as the standing action toward offenders.

activation_trace.role: Act-production turns the backward-pointing manner expression into an executable procedure.
Offense defines the class across cohorts to which the procedure applies.
Falling into destruction supplies the terminal operation in the repeated procedure.
Beginning and precedence identify the first cohort in the historical series.
Succession and continuity provide the relay that carries the operation from cohort to cohort.
Later-than-first closes the two-cohort pattern and exposes its repeatability.

structural_cues: 77:16-18 forms one progression from former peoples, to later peoples made to follow, to the focus generalization.
The focus manner-deictic points immediately backward to that progression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction, first/later ordering, and succession; I infer that the manner-deictic abstracts all three into a repeatable procedure. A live alternative is that it points only to destruction, not to the serial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A single unspecified punitive act is applied to criminals.
changed_reading.after: The clause states a transgenerational procedure in which later offender cohorts are routed into the already realized fate of earlier ones.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering first creates one total field; separation then establishes the decisive boundary within it. The cutting branch of ج ر م lets the focus action be reconstructed as judicial sorting and severance, not undifferentiated destruction.

activation_trace.role: Enacted agency supplies the operation that performs the sorting.
Cutting and harvesting make severance from a collected whole visible in the target root.
Separating one thing from another supplies the boundary-making phase of judgment.
Joining dispersed parties into one whole supplies the prior collection phase.

structural_cues: 77:13-14 repeatedly identifies a day of separation.
77:38 places that day directly beside the gathering of the audience and former peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering and separation in one scene; I infer the procedural arrow collection then sorting, with the focus root's cutting branch naming the offenders' side of the boundary. Separation could alternatively denote adjudication without a spatial sorting image.

changed_reading.before: The focus act destroys a criminal class as an undifferentiated block.
changed_reading.after: The focus act can be a two-stage judgment: gather the whole, then cut out or distinguish the offender class.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, state-placement, measured planning, and enclosure form a material handling chain. The bodily-mass branch of ج ر م shifts the recipients from an abstract legal label to embodied beings already produced, placed, bounded, and contained by the same agency.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being allows the focus verb to inherit a material process template.
Bodily bulk and shaped mass make the offender class materially embodied within that process.
Estimating and measuring a thing supplies formative specification at the process entrance.
Making something enter a state supplies deliberate placement within the process.
Planning by measure and assessment supplies calibration rather than arbitrary force.
Gathering and holding in a receptacle supplies the enclosing endpoint of material handling.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from origin material through a firm resting place to a known measure.
77:25-27 presents the earth as holding living and dead while supporting stable heights and water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chain of making, placing, measuring, and enclosing; I infer that the same plural agent lets this chain reframe the otherwise generic focus action. The live alternative is that this creation sequence is evidentiary background rather than a template for action upon offenders.

changed_reading.before: Criminals are a purely juridical class subjected to punishment.
changed_reading.after: They are also embodied, measured recipients inside a continuous system of formation, placement, containment, and eventual judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later parallel manner construction explicitly links beneficial outcome to purposeful work and recompense, while the repeated criminal designation carries earning or incurrence. Together they turn the focus action into the adverse pole of a conduct-responsive exchange.

activation_trace.role: Mutual action supplies the relational architecture for conduct and counter-outcome.
Earning and causing liability make the offender's status an acquired input to the response.
Purposeful work supplies the conduct side of the response relation.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the directional return from conduct to outcome.
Doing what is good identifies the positive actor class in the parallel construction.
The repeated earning-or-incurrence root identifies the adverse actor class near the positive parallel.

structural_cues: 77:44 repeats the focus's manner-deictic construction but pairs it with recompense and good-doers.
77:43 links enjoyment to prior work, while 77:46 names the adverse counterpart as criminals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near constructional parallel and explicit conduct/outcome language; I infer that the two clauses form positive and adverse poles of one responsive regime. A live alternative is rhetorical symmetry without a strict reciprocal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an arbitrary or merely sovereign act against criminals.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the adverse counterpart of recompensing good-doers: an outcome responsive to what each class has enacted or incurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: One group is sent toward something named as shade but stripped of shade's sufficing function; another occupies shade whose function is protection. The generic focus action therefore gains a spatial mechanism of functional inversion rather than simple infliction.

activation_trace.role: Act-production supplies deliberate environmental placement as a mode of action.
Offense fixes which class receives the failed-refuge environment.
Covering shade supplies the apparent promise of refuge presented to the offender class.
Sufficiency names the protective function explicitly denied to that apparent refuge.
Shelter and protection supply the successful counterpart occupied by the protected class.
Warding off harm supplies the criterion distinguishing real refuge from its failed likeness.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 offers a three-branched shade and immediately negates both shade and protection from flame.
77:41 places the protected class in plural shades, creating a same-root contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same shelter root in failed and successful environments plus explicit non-sufficiency and protection; I infer that environmental reversal is one way the focus agent acts with the two classes. The alternative is that the contrast is descriptive scenery, not a mechanism of the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Action against criminals consists only in direct destruction.
changed_reading.after: Action can operate by placing them inside the likeness of refuge while removing refuge's defining protective function.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed endpoint combines with temporarily extended enjoyment, explicit smallness, and the time-completion branch of ج ر م. The focus action can thus include deferment itself: allowance is bounded in advance and becomes the approach to cutoff.

activation_trace.role: Act-production lets temporal allowance count as part of the operative treatment.
Completed and cut-off time opens a temporal profile within the offender root.
A prescribed temporal limit supplies the fixed endpoint of the process.
Keeping benefit available for an interval supplies temporary extension before the endpoint.
Smallness constrains the extension and prevents it from reading as durable security.
The repeated criminal designation activates completed time and cutoff at the point of temporary enjoyment.

structural_cues: 77:12 asks to which day the messengers have been deferred, foregrounding a scheduled endpoint.
77:46 grants only a little enjoyment while naming the addressees with the same root as the focus target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deadline, temporary benefit, smallness, and repeated offender terminology; I infer that extension and cutoff are phases of one action. A live alternative is that the temporal expressions govern separate episodes and do not specify the focus clause's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus action is an immediate terminal blow.
changed_reading.after: It can include a controlled interval of enjoyment whose premeasured brevity carries its own approaching termination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a branch-distant sonic sense of the focus target root rather than its ordinary offense sense. It remains anchored through root ج ر م at focus word 3 and is directly awakened by the later removal of speech, permission, and excuse. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary sonic-legal activation, never as a replacement translation for the offender noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Root ج ر م at focus word 3 has a packet branch concerning voice resonance emerging from the body.

activation_trace.role: Voice emerging resonantly from the body supplies the unusual capacity upon which the action can operate.
Speech and articulation identify the bodily output that is removed.
Permission supplies the legal gate that remains closed to speech.
Excuse identifies the defensive content prevented from emerging.

changed_reading.before: The criminals are only a legal-moral class receiving judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the action also reaches their embodied capacity to externalize a defense: voice, permission, and excuse are jointly closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it materializes a moral noun as post-harvest residue. It remains anchored in the residue branch of focus root ج ر م and gains a coherent ecology from chaff, scattering, and airborne uprooted matter elsewhere in the packet. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for judgment, not as the noun's direct contextual gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Root ج ر م at focus word 3 includes a packet branch for residue and dried matter left after harvest.

activation_trace.role: Post-harvest residue supplies the material state assigned exploratorily to the offender class.
Fragmented crop husk supplies the light material produced by threshing or stripping.
Scattering into parts supplies the separation process that yields residue.
Matter sent flying or raised supplies the residue's final dispersed motion.

changed_reading.before: The focus treats criminals as juridical agents.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the surah's sorting forces leave the offender class like dry residue dispersed after harvest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from focus root ف ع ل to a parental-nurture inventory. It remains formally packet-authorized and contextually activated by creation, settling, and watering, but it is mapping-distant. Downstream prose should call it a custodial prehistory of the punitive act and must not claim that the focus verb lexically means parenting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory for root ف ع ل at focus word 2 includes non-dominant mapped target root_000007 and its nurture branch.

activation_trace.role: Parental nurture and corrective care supply the deliberately form-distant custodial overlay on divine action.
Offense preserves the focus sentence's actual target class and prevents the overlay from floating free.
Originating created life supplies the custodial relation's beginning.
Stability and settlement supply a protected developmental interval.
Giving drink supplies ongoing provision within the custodial sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus action appears solely punitive and begins at judgment.
changed_reading.after: In a heavily qualified mapping-induced reading, action toward the eventual offender class has a prior custodial arc of originating, settling, and provisioning before judgment.

strongest_changes: The immediate context turns the focus into a repeatable historical procedure: earlier destruction followed by later cohorts entering the same outcome.
The later parallel construction makes the action conduct-responsive, the adverse counterpart to recompensing good-doers.
Gathering plus separation revises raw destruction into collection followed by judicial sorting and severance.
Creation, placement, measure, and enclosure recover an embodied and calibrated process beneath the legal label.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed both the immediate backward referent of the manner-deictic and a later positive constructional counterpart, while material, spatial, temporal, and speech sequences kept several non-equivalent mechanisms alive.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact scope of the focus manner-deictic remains open: it may point only to destruction or to the entire former-to-later procedure.
The material, temporal, and sonic branches may be contextual analogies rather than active lexical senses in the focus noun.
The custodial reading depends on a non-dominant split mapping and should remain an explicitly contained outlier.
